method.teacher_system: The teacher breaks down advanced dance execution into foundational components such as initiations, finishes, textures, and dynamics. She demonstrates how modifying these elements allows dancers to develop personal style and match specific choreography.
method.signature: Using varied physical analogies and objects (like balloons, honey, and clocks) to visually explain abstract dance textures.

practices.what: Use a balloon analogy to demonstrate how a move starts fast, then moves slow and floaty.

beliefs.belief: Good or amazing dancing is extremely subjective and you can just dance the way you want.
